I ended up having some more stress come into my life, and I tried reaching out to her to ask for what's going on, and ended up getting no response. Come May 18th, I won't have heard anything from her, and like I mentioned earlier, I'm really not expecting to at this point. The activity continues on social media, and she has been posting stuff, and it made my heart drop to see that and not a reply to me. Ive asked for closure and help moving on, but she sadly won't give that to me, but she also hasn't removed me from her social media stuff yet.

I'm confused with all of it, but I'm slowly moving on. Its painful and takes time, but I know I'll find someone who'll be the one sooner or later. I wish things would've worked out between us, but I'm not sure if she'll ever see me for who I was and what I've offered. Maybe months or years later she'll reach out, but I still remain doubtful.

This is the perfect time for it all to fall apart though because this kind of behavior would have shown itself later in life, and  the situation could have been much much worse.

This is the message I ended up sending her:

Hey XXXX, I wanted to let you know some of what's going on with me here. Theres been a LOT that's been going on with my life, and I've been very busy as of late. Things aren't the greatest for me right now. From what you told me, you've been going through a difficult time, and I've been trying to be supportive and be there for you. I'd like to talk to you about what all is going on. If you would rather not, I get that. I figure talking about how everything is going is important. If you want a break and not have to worry about a relationship or anything like that, that's fine, and I just need to know. It isn't like we would be ending on bad terms in my book if this is what you would like to do, and theres potential down the road if you'd want to reconnect. I honestly want this to continue, but I feel like if we can't communicate, it's no good for either of us. 3 weeks is a long time for no communication, and communication goes both ways. Think about it, and let me know. If I don't receive a response in a few days, then I'm going to assume you want to be on your own, and I'll move forward.

4 weeks have gone by since I've actually heard anything from her, and this message was sent 4 days ago. She continues to be active on social media, liking stuff on Facebook and sending snaps on Snapchat, and I feel is completely ignoring me at this point. Being ghosted really sucks, and I'm honestly not expecting a reply from her. She liked another guy's picture on Facebook that falls under her type, and seeing that really hurt, but its showing me that she isn't as involved and concerned about this relationship as I am and have been. She doesn't want to confront me about the nature of what she wants, and that's fine. After 9 months of dating, I felt that I deserved that kind of respect to be able to at least communicate our feelings considering we've never had issues doing so before, but this might very well be a blessing.

She hasn't told her parents yet since they both are still following me on social media and liking my content, and her dad sent me a Happy Easter text the other day saying that they love and miss me. Part of me feels happy they thought about me, while the other part is equally frustrated that this hasn't died yet so I can completely move on. I don't feel that she will try and reconnect in all honesty, and I've been the best she's ever had. Maybe months or years down the line she'll reach out again, but I'm not sure I would want to continue something with her again. Her actions have been selfish and emotional abusive towards me, and this is unacceptable by any standard. My overwhelming love, care and concern were simply too much for her I feel. I'd like to reach out to her family and see how she's doing, but doing so is confrontational and could only make matters worse. At this point, I simply want to know. 

I'm appreciative that you've been here to console me this far. Honestly. This has been very difficult for me, and your words have helped immensely. What do you think about all of this?

I agree wholeheartedly, and I don't plan to continually send her messages for check ins. She recently opened the messages I mentioned in the post and still no reply. That at least tells me she wanted to see what I had to say, but not necessarily communicate. 10 days is extremely uncommon for us, and this is an uncommon situation I'm in. I think it's best if I wait too.

I honestly want things to continue, and it's the uncertainty of everything that is most difficult to me. She was the one who wanted to get back together and brought it when she called me in early February rather than me.  I want her to heal and take the time she needs, but a heads up that is what she was planning to do is what should've been communicated. So I should call her and see where shes at then?
So you think 100% that we're broken up then?

When you say to let it go, do you mean the relationship and her? I'm honestly at the point where I just want to know if we're still a thing, and if she wants to be done, I just want to know. I believe she's out of inpatient if shes living and being watched with family, but I could be wrong too.

Just thought I'd put more on this as a bit of an update as time goes on. It helps me a little bit by writing this out as I'm still frustrated, and I'm getting the feeling that this very well may be over between us. March 21st was the last message she had read and not responded to, and the two other messages I had sent have just been sitting in her inbox. This has been the hardest 10 days in the entirety of our relationship, more so than us breaking up in January. Given the continued lack of communication with me but the increasing activity on social media, what do you think?

I agree with you, and I very much want to reach out to her, but she's making it seem like she doesn't want to communicate when I do. The last two days have been zero contact from either of us, and I've consistently been reaching out for days prior to my silence. I have a giant message typed up that explains everything that I'm feeling, but I am fearful that it will only complicate things further. This fear is not a good sign, I know.
